We proceed to factor the left-hand side by grouping:

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}^{3}+5{y}^{2}-2y-10 & = \\ ({y}^{3}+5{y}^{2})-(2y+10) & = \\ {y}^{2}(y+5)-2(y+5) & = \\ (y+5)\cdot {y}^{2}-(y+5)\cdot 2 & = \\ (y+5)({y}^{2}-2) & .\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we solve $(y+5)({y}^{2}-2)=0$ by setting each factor equal to $0.$

- Setting the factor $(y+5)$ equal to $0,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}y+5 & =0 \\ y & =-5.\end{aligned}
$$

- Setting the factor $({y}^{2}-2)$ equal to $0,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}^{2}-2 & =0 \\ {y}^{2} & =2 \\ y & =\pm \sqrt{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solutions are $y=-5,\,\pm \sqrt{2}.$
